purpose: Make canonical companion operational through one production-registered protected router and explicit provider-neutral command whose only successful product handoff is a strictly classified current proposal persisted by the TASK-044-simplified authority, after TASK-042 has completed governance effects and TASK-040 has established the shared Task package plus provider-neutral runtime and Safety-classifier seams.
success_outcome: The complete Companion router is registered exactly once in the current post-TASK-046 production app after TASK-042/TASK-040 without changing FT-008 feed or lazy-introduction behavior; one authorized explicit POST deterministically selects the canonical check-in and exactly one manual-measurement row, invokes exactly one explicit Companion spy and one explicit safety_gate spy, maps their strict matching results through pending MessageEnvelope and persisted classification, and persists exactly one derived-current proposal with active attention through the TASK-044-simplified authority. Deterministic evidence covers strict schemas, authorization plus post-I/O recheck, exact outbound allowlists, timeout/error/invalid output, redaction, unbound production, and no fallback/fake production without provider/model/base URL/credential/egress/network/live-smoke requirements; duplicate/non-trigger/failure paths create no extra effect.
anti_goals: Do not widen generic ProviderRequestV1, MessageEnvelope, SafetyClassificationResultV1, roster identity, TASK-044-simplified proposal authority, or TASK-042 DecisionRecord semantics.
Do not add automatic domain-event, Task-completion, feed-refresh, startup, scheduler, worker, or reconciliation triggers.
Do not let the model decide, approve/reject, close, create a DecisionRecord or Task, authorize action, mutate Plant state, invoke tools/devices, or bypass classification/governance authority.
Do not add caller prompts/provider selection, UI/Bus/Timeline replay context, raw chat, memory, Team/tools/RAG, fallback, fake production output, or failure-silence substitution.
Do not omit the explicit test safety_gate fake/spy seam, merge pH/EC from different measurement rows, or treat generic independent pH/EC selection as Companion input.

Do not claim FT-013 acceptance from transport-only, schema-only, fake-production, fallback, or blocked/failed/model-silent output; require the complete deterministic authority and two-spy evidence matrix.

forbidden_scope: TASK-044-simplified tables/focus/attention/proposal lifecycle or TASK-042 DecisionRecord/effect/close semantics except a narrowly proven compatibility repair.
Generic ProviderRequestV1, MessageEnvelope, SafetyClassificationResultV1, or canonical roster identity widening.
Frontend/PWA, automatic triggers, UI Feed/Bus/Timeline replay, raw chat, governance fields outside the exact registered Companion request allowlist, caller prompt, or arbitrary provider selection.
Decision/approval/close/Task/action/completion/Outcome/Plant-state/device authority, automated actuation, tools, RAG, memory, fallback, or fake production output.
ChatGPT/Codex credential stores, default provider/model selection, or cross-provider retry.
stop_conditions: TASK-044-simplified proposal persistence cannot accept the validated runtime/classification handoff without widening its governance, effect, or authorization contract.
The provider-neutral runtime seams and patterns proven by TASK-040 cannot support a competence-specific Companion request without generic request widening or shared-file contract conflict.
The canonical project classifier cannot preserve exact proposed effect/task-kind matching for the governance handoff.
The deterministic Companion plus Safety fake/spy seams cannot prove exact calls and fail-closed production without fallback, fake production classification, or unredacted configuration.
Production composition would require fake/canned output, provider fallback, caller prompts, auth/UI/Bus/Timeline data egress, or direct decision/effect authority.
Existing uncommitted work makes shared provider/API/main/package edits unsafe to reconcile.

constraints: CompanionProviderRequestV1 contains only the canonical definition, explicit_user_command trigger, target mode, and one to four ordered authorized PostgreSQL records: Plant, selected issue with the exact persisted summary_text only for existing_issue, check-in by (recorded_at DESC,check_in_id DESC), and exactly one manual measurement by (measured_at DESC,measurement_id DESC), with no issue summary for new_issue, exactly matching refs, and no cross-row pH/EC synthesis.

CompanionModelResultV1 may speak only the closed governance proposal matrix or produce strict model-declared silence; action, physical/Safety approval, target, quantity, command, Plant-state, and unknown fields are schema-invalid.
Task effects map to a pending task_request envelope and require persisted safe_task_request with the exact same kind; discussion_only and none map to team_signal and require safe_information.
Only POST /api/plants/{plant_id}/companion/runs invokes the model; all reads, refreshes, events, Task completions, startup, and reconciliation paths are proven non-triggers.

TASK-043 alone edits backend/app/main.py for FT-013 and registers the already verified read/decision router plus run route only after both TASK-042 and TASK-040, making production composition sequential in the executable DAG.

Strict provider-neutral companion and safety_gate seams have no selected provider/model/base URL; production remains unbound and fail-closed, tests inject explicit fakes/spies, and no fallback exists. Sequential identical retry returns persisted refs with runtime_outcome=null before another call or MessageEnvelope construction; I/O is outside transactions and current guards repeat before TASK-041 persistence.

Deterministic acceptance requires exactly one Companion spy call, one Safety classifier spy call, and one classified current proposal; production fake, missing call, fallback, silence, blocked/mismatch, failure, or any direct Safety decision/DecisionRecord/Task/action effect is not acceptance.

Companion Governance remains the primary owner in backend/app/companion_governance; the API router and backend/app/main.py only adapt and compose it, while existing FT-008 feed registration and lazy-introduction behavior remain unchanged.
invariants: Model output, MessageEnvelope, and classification are candidate/routing data; only the TASK-044-simplified governance authority persists current proposal/attention and only TASK-042 plus a human command creates later binding decisions.
The Companion model can never approve/reject/close, create DecisionRecord or Task, grant Safety/action authority, confirm Plant state, or produce a device effect.

The registered Companion allowlist includes exact persisted current open-Issue summary_text for existing_issue as untrusted non-authoritative governance context; Farm/auth/session/grant, UI Feed, Bus/Timeline replay, raw chat, attention/proposal/rationale/decision/history/caller content, prompts, provider history, hidden reasoning, credentials, local paths, and every unlisted field stay outside provider input.
Archived, unauthorized, revoked, or version-stale scope creates no proposal/effect, and restore never replays the denied run.

No Companion runtime receipt or MessageEnvelope replay row is persisted; a committed duplicate is reconstructed only as safe governance/classification refs and never as a fresh common runtime outcome.
Test fakes/spies are explicit seams only; no fake, canned, hardcoded, fallback, or failure-silence production path satisfies acceptance.
